paper: 2022年 Science Translational Medicine 正式发表论文
report_says: 将该EID所引用的版本描述为“尚未经过同行评审的medRxiv预印本”。
judge_says: PMID:36070366对应的是2022年发表于Science Translational Medicine的正式同行评审论文，而非未经同行评审的预印本。medRxiv预印本另有独立DOI记录。报告虽然建立了预印本与正式发表版本的version_of关系，但没有正确区分实际引用的版本，导致同行评审状态标注错误。
report_quotes: NOTE: This preprint reports new research that has not been certified by peer review and should not be used to guide clinical practice.
doi: medRxiv preprint
judge_quotes: NOTE: This preprint reports new research that has not been certified by peer review and should not be used to guide clinical practice.
why: 全文明确将所附文本标识为medRxiv预印本，并明确声明该研究尚未经过同行评审，同时提供了独立的medRxiv DOI（10.1101/2022.02.08.22270370）。因此，就附件所代表的具体版本而言，报告将其描述为未经同行评审的medRxiv预印本有明确的全文依据。指控者的说法部分有依据：全文确实支持medRxiv预印本具有独立DOI这一点。但全文没有提及Science Translational Medicine，也没有提供PMID:36070366对应的正式发表版本的期刊信息、正式发表日期或出版DOI。因此，仅凭全文无法确认PMID对应的是另一个正式同行评审版本，更无法确认报告错误识别了EID实际引用的版本。不能将全文没有提供的版本对应关系当作已经证实的事实。

why: 报告的说法有全文明确依据。附件正文多处标注为medRxiv preprint，明确给出2025年5月9日的预印本发布时间、DOI 10.1101/2025.05.08.25327015，并明确说明该版本未经同行评审。因此，将附件所载文献描述为medRxiv预印本，并非与全文不符。指控者的说法属于部分有依据：全文确实同时出现PMID:40992964（标题行标注2026年）和独立的medRxiv预印本DOI，也明确区分了预印本的同行评审状态。但是，全文没有出现Parkinsonism & Related Disorders这一期刊名称，也没有提供该PMID对应正式期刊发表版本的出版信息或同行评审记录。因此，仅凭全文无法确认指控者关于正式发表版本及其与预印本关系的完整判断。不能因为存在PMID就否定附件明确标注的预印本属性，也不能仅凭预印本标注否定可能存在独立的正式发表版本。按照只依据全文的判断标准，报告的描述有直接依据，指控者的描述只有部分依据。

why: 全文明确将所提供的文章版本标记为 medRxiv preprint，并明确声明该研究尚未通过同行评审，因此报告将该版本描述为未经同行评审的 medRxiv 预印本，有直接的全文依据，应判定为 yes。指控者的说法只能判定为 partly：全文确实提供了预印本独立 DOI（10.1101/19011858），但没有提及该研究发表于 Brain Stimulation，也没有提供正式期刊版本的出版信息，更没有明确说明 PMID:32634599 对应的是正式同行评审版本而非预印本。因此，指控者关于正式发表版本与预印本版本的区分，无法仅凭这份全文得到完整证实。不能因为全文展示的是预印本版本，就推断不存在正式发表版本；同样也不能仅凭指控者的陈述认定 PMID 对应正式期刊版本。按照只依据全文的判断标准，报告的说法有明确依据，而指控者的核心出版状态判断缺少全文证据。

paper: Zhuang et al., 2026, Gait-cycle-locked cortico-subthalamic signatures underlying freezing of gait and their modulation in Parkinson's disease
report_says: 结构化附录将该研究的证据来源标记为abstract，并将样本量记录为“摘要未报告”。
judge_says: 该研究已经发表开放获取全文，不应仅按摘要级证据处理。报告没有充分阅读全文提取数据，因而将样本量记为摘要未报告，反映了对原文的核验和数据提取不充分。

paper: Syrkin-Nikolau et al., 2017, Subthalamic neural entropy is a feature of freezing of gait in freely moving people with Parkinson's disease；另涉及一篇2026年关于STN beta burst timing及FOG的预印本（评审意见未提供具体题名和作者）
report_says: 报告第五节5.4将H11与H12描述为针对同一神经现象提出相反的时间顺序和行为结果预测，将不同熵及复杂度指标组织成同一现象的竞争性机制解释。
judge_says: 2017年研究实际发现的是：真实FOG发生期间，STN alpha频段（8–12 Hz）的Sample Entropy高于无冻结步行期间。2026年预印本涉及的则是冻结前转弯期间beta burst timing的Shannon entropy下降，以及Lempel-Ziv complexity升高。两者的分析算法、频段、时间阶段和比较基线均不同，不能视为同一种神经现象的相反解释，也不能仅凭指标方向相反就建立病理性与代偿性的竞争假说。
report_quotes: According to the entropy hypothesis, the increased entropy demonstrated in Freezers compared to non-freezers during normal stepping and in Freezers themselves during periods of FOG may suggest greater errors in subthalamic outflow sensorimotor information processing in Freezers and motor inhibition, which may be reflected in abnormal gait patterns when not freezing, and during FOG.

In contrast to the entropy hypothesis outlined above, an alternate hypothesis has been proposed: high beta power and low beta entropy represent lower information transfer capacity in sensorimotor cortical rhythms and in the STN LFP at the onset and offset of movement...

This alternative hypothesis would suggest that the low beta power and high beta entropy seen in the current study would lead to higher information transfer in sensorimotor rhythms that may reflect a compensatory attempt to overcome the abnormal gait in Freezers.

These results support the current neuronal entropy hypothesis and suggest that greater unpredictability in the STN beta rhythm may contribute to more asymmetric and arrhythmic gait and greater unpredictability in alpha rhythms may contribute to FOG. Conversely increased entropy in alpha/beta rhythms may be a compensatory attempt to improve the gait impairment.
judge_quotes: The predictability of the LFPs (band-pass filtered between 8–12 Hz for alpha and 13–30 Hz for beta) was analyzed using Sample Entropy 11 (SampEn), a nonlinear measure suitable for physiological time series.
Freezers also showed increased alpha SampEn during FOG when compared to walking without FOG (F(1, 51) = 7.67, P = 0.005).
Nonlinear signal analysis demonstrated that SampEn in the beta band was greater during SIP (without FOG) in Freezers compared to Non-Freezers (H(1) = 4.61, P = 0.032).

FOG in the FW and TBC tasks were identified in the video recordings by a neurologist as a change from the subject’s forward walking pattern that included shortened, faster steps (festination) and periods of no forward motion.
why: 报告的说法部分有依据。2017年论文确实明确提出了两种相竞争的机制解释：一种认为较高的神经熵反映信息处理错误和运动抑制，具有病理意义；另一种认为较高的beta熵可能提高感觉运动信息传递，是克服步态障碍的代偿机制。论文甚至明确使用“In contrast”和“alternate hypothesis”描述两者，并在结论中指出熵增加可能具有病理作用，也可能具有代偿作用。因此，不能认为报告凭空建立了病理性与代偿性的竞争解释。但是，论文并未提出H11与H12具有相反的时间顺序预测，也没有把所有熵及复杂度指标认定为同一个神经现象。尤其需要区分两项实际结果：beta SampEn是在无FOG的原地踏步（SIP）期间比较Freezers与Non-Freezers；alpha SampEn则是在Freezers内部比较FOG期间与无FOG步行期间。论文的替代假说主要针对低beta功率和高beta熵，并引用了既往beta复杂度研究，不能据此推导出所有不同指标、频段和行为阶段都是同一现象的相反预测。因此，报告的总体机制解释有依据，但其时间顺序和现象同一性的表述缺少全文支持。指控者的说法也部分有依据：其对2017年研究的alpha频段发现描述准确，论文明确报告了FOG期间alpha SampEn高于无冻结步行期间。不过，这不是2017年论文唯一的熵结果，论文还报告了无FOG原地踏步期间Freezers的beta SampEn高于Non-Freezers。指控者关于2026年预印本的Shannon entropy、Lempel-Ziv complexity、beta burst timing及比较基线的描述，均无法从本附件的2017年全文核实；同样，两个研究之间的算法、频段和时间阶段是否确实不同，也不能仅凭这篇论文完整确认。故不能把指控者的整体说法评为全文明确支持，也不能认定其与全文矛盾。

paper: PMID:40383539，Effects of theta burst stimulation on the Parkinsonian gait disorder and cortical gait-network activity
report_says: 将该研究作为H19“暂停期间病理性网络输入重新显现”和H20“长期网络可塑性及跨日适应机制”的重要来源，用于构建TBS-DBS的竞争性机制假说。
judge_says: 原研究是15名帕金森病患者参与的短期随机双盲研究，整体主要FOG结局没有显示TBS-DBS优于连续DBS，只有7/15名患者主观评价TBS-DBS相等或更好。研究没有直接测量STN神经活动，没有操控不同刺激暂停时长，也没有开展长期随访。H19所依据的暂停后病理性输入重新显现主要来自丘脑刺激与震颤研究，而非STN刺激期间FOG的直接神经记录；H20所依据的长期可塑性则来自其他神经系统及突触可塑性研究。因此，不能将该试验视为这两种STN-FOG机制的直接实验支持。
report_quotes: The spacing of stimulation trains and insertion of stimulation pauses with TBS-DBS might represent a double-edged sword for DBS application.
On the one hand, there is evidence of re-emerging tremor during spaced thalamic deep brain stimulation depending on the length and timing of the stimulation pause.
The finding of impaired, short-term efficacy in tremor suppression by non-continuous DBS was interpreted as the inability to mask burst-driver inputs to the thalamus.

On the other hand, we assumed TBS-DBS to be potentially advantageous for gait due to the following reasons: (1) Previous studies suggested that nonregular patterns of STN-DBS with pauses were more effective in desynchronizing neural activity in PD and treatment-refractory obsessive-compulsive disorder compared to standard STN-DBS.
TBS-DBS with its temporal patterning might slowly, progressively increase its subthalamic efficacy in the long-term by beneficial neuroplastic effects from TBS-DBS.
In the visuo-tectal systems or the hippocampus it was shown that bursting effects play a predominant role in determining the precision and specificity of synaptic plasticity.
Since axial symptoms might change over days, the EEG might potentially point to advantageous long-term changes, which could not be proven in that acute experimental setting.
judge_quotes: In this monocentric, randomised, double-blind, short-term study, 12 age-matched controls (11 male, age 59 ± 8 years) and 15 PD participants (14 male, age 62 ± 9 years, disease duration 15 ± 6 years) with subthalamic stimulation (76 ± 39 months) were assessed with clinical scores (FoG-Course, MDS-UPDRS) and a standardized gait course simulating everyday life situations.
The primary outcome, the relative change of FoG-Course by DBS, was not superior with TBS-DBS compared to cDBS in the entire sample.

All 15 PD participants were asked to subjectively rate the TBS-DBS condition when still blinded. 4 PD participants rated TBS better (4 PD participants), equal (3 PD participants) or worse (8 PD participants) compared to cDBS.

The aims of the present, single-center, randomized, double-blind study were to (1) assess the effects of bilateral TBS-DBS on gait and FoG in PD patients by using established clinical scores, quantitative gait analysis with wearable kinematic sensors in real life gait conditions and (2) cortical network changes measured by a mobile EEG system.
In detail, the TBS pattern consists of 5 cycles per second, with each cycle containing 0.1s bursts at 200 Hz followed by a 0.1s pause.

The most important limitation in the evaluation of patterned DBS algorithms is the assessment of short-term effects of TBS-DBS on gait within one day, since the effects of patterned DBS might evolve over time and axial symptoms typically respond over a longer time course.
For the exploration of the full effect strength, a long-term evaluation of TBS-DBS would be necessary, which has not been performed here in the randomised study of short-term effects.
On the one hand, there is evidence of re-emerging tremor during spaced thalamic deep brain stimulation depending on the length and timing of the stimulation pause.
The finding of impaired, short-term efficacy in tremor suppression by non-continuous DBS was interpreted as the inability to mask burst-driver inputs to the thalamus.
TBS-DBS with its temporal patterning might slowly, progressively increase its subthalamic efficacy in the long-term by beneficial neuroplastic effects from TBS-DBS.
In the visuo-tectal systems or the hippocampus it was shown that bursting effects play a predominant role in determining the precision and specificity of synaptic plasticity.
why:
两个判断可以同时成立，并不矛盾。report_supported为yes：论文Discussion第216—232行明确提出了TBS-DBS的双重机制假说。一方面，刺激暂停可能使丘脑的burst-driver病理性输入重新显现，从而削弱短期疗效；另一方面，间歇性刺激可能通过神经活动去同步化及长期神经可塑性改善步态。论文还明确提及轴性症状可能随时间发生变化。因此，将该论文作为H19和H20竞争性机制假说的重要文献来源，有直接的全文依据。

judge_supported为yes：但上述内容属于作者结合既往研究提出的机制解释，并非本试验直接验证的机制。具体而言：（1）研究是15名帕金森病患者参与的单中心、随机、双盲、短期研究；主要FoG-Course结局未显示TBS-DBS优于cDBS。（2）15人中只有4人主观评价TBS-DBS更好、3人评价相等，另外8人评价更差。（3）研究使用移动EEG测量的是皮层活动，并未直接记录STN神经活动。（4）TBS-DBS采用固定的0.1秒暂停，没有比较不同暂停时长。（5）研究在单日实验中评估短期效应，没有进行长期随访。

尤其重要的是，H19的burst-driver输入重新显现，原文明确指向既往间歇性丘脑DBS的震颤研究（thalamic deep brain stimulation），随后才将其作为解释TBS-DBS步态及FOG短期疗效可能较差的假说。H20的神经可塑性论证则主要引用视觉顶盖系统、海马及突触可塑性研究，并明确承认本研究没有进行长期验证。值得补充的是，作者还引用了另一项PD患者长期TBS-DBS研究，但这同样不能替代本试验自身的长期证据。

最终结论：报告将该研究用于构建两种竞争性机制假说，没有违背全文；指控者认为该试验不能作为这两种机制的直接实验支持，也完全符合全文。必须区分文献对机制假说的提出和本试验对机制的实证检验。不能因为机制没有在本试验中得到验证，就认定报告引用该论文构建假说属于误读。

paper: Cascino et al., 2026, Chronic adaptive deep brain stimulation in Parkinson's disease: ADAPT-START findings and programming principles
report_says: 报告第三节3.10仍将ADAPT-START称为慢性aDBS的预印本研究，并报告20人获邀、9人接受适用性评估、5人进入长期aDBS阶段。
judge_says: 该研究已经于2026年2月25日正式发表，正式论文题为Chronic adaptive deep brain stimulation in Parkinson's disease: ADAPT-START findings and programming principles。正式发表版本仍报告20人获邀、9人符合条件、5人持续接受慢性aDBS。因此，报告中的人数数据并没有被评委指出错误，明确的事实性错误是将已经正式发表的研究继续标记为预印本，没有区分预印本版本与正式发表版本。
